scenes.title: Copilot: choose the right AI assistant for the job
scenes.body: Bottom line: Copilot is a family, not one tool; choose Chat, Microsoft 365, GitHub, or Studio by job, then verify access, licensing, and grounding.
scenes.narration: Bottom line: Copilot is a family, not one tool; choose Chat, Microsoft 365, GitHub, or Studio by job, then verify access, licensing, and grounding.
claims: Copilot Chat supports research, content generation, file analysis, images, agents, and supported organizational questions.
Microsoft 365 Copilot is shaped by organizational grounding, user permissions, compliance controls, work-app access, and license level.
GitHub Copilot supports coding work in editors, the command line, and GitHub, including completing code, edits, validation, and workflow support.
Copilot Studio is a low-code route for building agents and workflows connected to organizational data, systems, and channels.
The executive choice is job first, then access, licensing, grounding, and output scope.
